name: Innovate UK Women in Innovation Awards
description: Awards programme supporting women-led SMEs with grant funding plus coaching and networking. Includes a 12-month support package.
eligibility: UK-registered SME with a woman founder or co-founder

name: Innovate UK Growth Catalyst - Investor Partnerships
description: Blended grant and private investment programme for health tech MVP development. Combines government grant with matched private investment.
eligibility: UK-registered SME

name: SBRI Healthcare - NHS Challenge Competitions
funder: Small Business Research Initiative / NHS England
description: NHS challenge competitions seeking innovative solutions for healthcare problems including falls prevention, mental health, and preventable admissions.
eligibility: SMEs and organisations with innovative NHS solutions

name: Wellbeing of Women - Corporate Partnerships
description: Corporate sponsorship programme for women's health charities. Includes partnership opportunities modelled on Simplyhealth's Women's Healthcare Charity Alliance.
eligibility: Charities and CICs focused on women's health

name: Haemophilia Society - Partnership Opportunities
description: Charity partnership programme including joint advocacy, corporate sponsorship leveraging, and event collaboration for bleeding disorder organisations.
eligibility: Organisations working with bleeding disorders

name: Blood Cancer UK - Corporate Partnerships Model
description: Corporate CSR partnership model targeting pharma, healthcare, and insurance companies. Adaptable by blood disorder charities seeking corporate sponsors.
eligibility: Charities in the blood disorder and healthcare space

name: Marshall Impact Accelerator (LSE)
funder: Marshall Institute, London School of Economics
description: Social impact accelerator backed by GBP50M endowment. Platform for promising social ventures tackling global challenges in health, environment, and social inequality.
deadline: Check LSE website for cohort deadlines
eligibility: Social ventures tackling global challenges

name: Steve Morgan Foundation Regional Grants
description: Transformative multi-year grants for charities in the North West and North Wales. Includes the Type 1 Diabetes Grand Challenge model for moonshot health initiatives.
eligibility: Charities and organisations in North West England or North Wales

name: Creative Industries Clusters Programme
description: GBP100M+ investment in collaborations between universities, businesses, and cultural entities for R&D and innovation in creative industries.
eligibility: University-business collaborations and creative industry clusters

name: Creative Places Growth Fund
description: GBP150M fund devolved to Mayoral Strategic Authorities for regional creative industries development outside London.
eligibility: Creative organisations in priority regions, via regional authorities

name: ICE UK Consortium (EIT Culture & Creativity)
funder: Creative UK / European Institute of Innovation & Technology
description: National vehicle for engaging with EIT Culture & Creativity programme. Expands networks and influences funding design for UK cultural and creative sectors.
eligibility: UK cultural and creative sector organisations

name: BFI National Lottery Creative Challenge Fund
description: Financial support for UK-based organisations designing and delivering creative development programmes to strengthen the screen ecosystem.
eligibility: UK-based organisations (production companies, film festivals)

name: BFI National Lottery Innovation Challenge Fund
description: GBP1.8M fund for not-for-profit organisations to innovate and develop new solutions in the screen sector.
eligibility: Not-for-profit organisations

name: Creative Enterprise by Creative UK
description: Business development training programme equipping screen businesses with skills, confidence, and networks to attract funding and scale.
eligibility: Screen sector businesses in England

name: Creative Catalyst Programme
description: Investment and non-financial support programme for micro and small creative businesses, including business development coaching.
eligibility: Micro and small creative businesses

name: Procurement Act 2023 - Social Value Contracts
description: The Procurement Act 2023 introduces social value considerations alongside value for money, SME access improvements, and a single digital platform for public procurement.
eligibility: UK-registered organisations, especially SMEs and social enterprises

name: NHS Urgent and Emergency Care Plan Funding
description: GBP250M fund for Same Day Emergency Care and Urgent Treatment Centre expansion. Organisations can partner with NHS Trusts to deliver innovative care solutions.
eligibility: Organisations partnering with NHS Trusts

name: NHS Federated Data Platform - Integration Opportunities
description: Opportunities to integrate screening and predictive analytics into the NHS Federated Data Platform, covering 85% of acute trusts by March 2026.
eligibility: Health tech organisations with data platform capabilities

name: Primary Care Utilisation and Modernisation Fund
description: GBP102M fund for 2025-2026 to improve GP facilities, workforce capacity, and primary care infrastructure including training and screening tools.
eligibility: Organisations partnering with primary care networks

name: Create Growth Programme
description: GBP3M programme for innovation projects in 12 English regions, providing business management, fundraising skills, and investor network access for creative businesses.
eligibility: Creative businesses in designated English regions

name: Creative East Programme
description: Fully funded 12-week workshop programme covering business strategy and planning, investment funding processes, and creative business affairs.
eligibility: Creative businesses in East of England

name: Creative Business Skills Bootcamps
description: Fully funded bootcamps covering branding, marketing, project management, income streams, networking, legal, HR, sales, and business planning. Includes rent-free space.
eligibility: Creative businesses in Yorkshire

name: BFI Skills Fund - Exhibition and Distribution
description: GBP1.35M programme through March 2029 for leadership and business development training for exhibition and distribution sector leaders.
eligibility: Exhibition and distribution leaders in the screen sector

name: DCMS Createch Futures Programme
description: GBP25M programme combining creative innovation with cutting-edge technology, supporting digital skills and creative technologies including VR, games, and immersive reality.
eligibility: Creative technology companies and organisations

name: Innovation Accelerators Programme
description: GBP140M across three city regions (Glasgow, Manchester, West Midlands) for R&D innovation projects. Glasgow alone projected to deliver 446 high-value jobs.
eligibility: Organisations in Glasgow, Manchester, or West Midlands city regions

name: Thriving Communities Fund (Social Prescribing)
funder: Arts Council England / National Academy for Social Prescribing
description: GBP1.4M fund for local social prescribing activities connecting arts and culture with health outcomes.
eligibility: Arts and cultural organisations delivering social prescribing activities

name: Creative Health Leads Programme
description: 2-year salary subsidy for Creative Health Lead positions at NHS Band 7 level, integrating creative health into the wider health system.
eligibility: Organisations with creative health programmes partnering with NHS

name: Culturally Mindful Creative Health Residency
description: Paid training, mentoring, and residencies for Global Majority artists to collaboratively design health and wellbeing support programmes.
eligibility: Global Majority artists

name: UK Government Equal, Safe and Free Fund (LGBT+)
description: GBP40M five-year programme advancing LGBT+ rights globally. Includes flexible grants to grassroots LGBT+ organisations via the LGBT+ Solidarity Fund.
eligibility: Grassroots LGBT+ organisations

name: Pride in London Unity Fund
description: GBP100K total for 2026-2027 supporting LGBTQ+ grassroots organisations. Project Grants up to GBP5K and Micro Grants up to GBP500.
eligibility: Registered charity, CIC, CIO, or constituted community group in London

name: Manchester Pride Community Fund
description: Grants of GBP250-GBP1,000 for grassroots LGBTQ+ community groups to improve quality of life and wellbeing in Manchester.
eligibility: Grassroots LGBTQ+ community groups in Manchester

name: National Lottery Heritage Fund - LGBTQ+ Heritage
description: GBP12M+ invested since 1994 in LGBTQ+ heritage projects including creativity and activism preservation.
eligibility: Organisations with LGBTQ+ heritage projects

name: Arts Council England Cultural Development Fund
description: GBP16.2M total for capital investment in cultural and creative industries' physical infrastructure, with individual grants of GBP2M-GBP5M to local partnerships.
eligibility: Local partnerships led by local authorities or similar entities

name: Creative Foundations Fund (Capital Projects)
description: GBP425M for approximately 300 capital projects in arts venues across England, investing in cultural and creative industries infrastructure.
eligibility: Arts venues and cultural organisations
